ev.q: Among 99,618 female respondents aged 12–44 years, 3,006 (3%) reported a current pregnancy.
Past 12 months drinking was reported by 76.1% of first trimester respondents and 59.8% of second or third trimester respondents
Current drinking (at least one drink in the past 30 days) was reported by 19.6% of respondents
Among pregnant respondents, past 12 months drinking, current drinking, and binge drinking prevalence estimates were 64.7%, 9.8%, and 4.5%, respectively

methods_quotes.q: Prevalence estimates and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for past 12 months drinking, current drinking, and binge drinking were calculated overall
Analyses were conducted using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute) with SUDAAN (version 11.0; RTI International) to account for the complex sampling method
Data were weighted to adjust for nonresponse and to generate nationally representative estimates.
Estimates are not presented because the relative standard error was >30%.
